# drawbridge — long-form video streaming domains
#
# Curated and pinned by SHA-256 in dist/policy.json, unlike the large upstream
# lists which rotate daily. Entries cover the parent domain only; matching is
# suffix-based, so `netflix.com` also blocks `www.netflix.com`.
#
# This is the *deliberate* half of the streaming category: services people pay
# for, which are blocked by default and can be switched back on in one move with
# the "Allow long-form video streaming" option. The option's allowed_domains
# mirror this file exactly, and policytool.py sign fails if the two drift, since
# allow beats block and a domain listed here but missing there would be one the
# toggle silently fails to restore.
#
# YouTube is NOT here. It lives in social.txt under its own option, because a
# recommendation feed and a Short are a different thing from a film somebody sat
# down to watch. Keeping them apart is what lets a parent allow one and not the
# other.
#
# Every domain below resolved when it was added, and every package id in the
# policy's blocked_packages was checked against its Play Store listing rather
# than guessed. Blim TV was on the requested list and is not here: it was
# dissolved in March 2023 and folded into ViX, and its domain no longer resolves.

# --- Global services ---------------------------------------------------------

# Netflix. nflxvideo.net is the CDN, the rest are API and image hosts.
netflix.com
nflximg.net
nflxvideo.net
nflxext.com
nflxso.net

# Amazon Prime Video. Only the video-specific names: amazon.com itself stays
# reachable, because a shop and a streaming service are not the same thing.
primevideo.com
amazonvideo.com
aiv-cdn.net
aiv-delivery.net
atv-ps.amazon.com

# Disney+. bamgrid.com and dssott.com are BAMTech, the playback backend.
disneyplus.com
disney-plus.net
disneystreaming.com
bamgrid.com
dssott.com

# Hulu
hulu.com
hulustream.com
huluim.com

# HBO Max. max.com redirects to hbomax.com; both are listed because a redirect
# is resolved after DNS, not before it.
max.com
hbomax.com
hbomaxcdn.com
hbo.com

# Apple TV. The host only — apple.com carries the App Store, iCloud, Find My and
# activation, and suffix matching would take all of it with the parent domain.
tv.apple.com

# Paramount+
paramountplus.com
cbsivideo.com
cbsaavideo.com

# Odysee

# PeerTube. These are the project's own hosts. The federation is thousands of
# independent instances on their own domains, so this is the app and the front
# door rather than the network — see the note in policy.md.
joinpeertube.org
framatube.org

# --- Broadcasters whose streaming service shares a domain with their news -----
#
# These four are public-facing broadcasters as well as streaming platforms, and
# DNS cannot see a path. Blocking the streaming host alone leaves the service
# reachable at the parent (itv.com/watch, tv4.se/play); blocking the parent takes
# the newsroom with it. Both are listed, deliberately and separately, so that
# whoever disagrees can delete four lines rather than unpick the file.
itvx.com
itv.com
tv4play.se
tv4.se
play.tv2.no
tv2.no
tv2.dk
